home.intro_text: L'Attrape-Rêves is a family amusement park and discovery farm nestled in the Cévennes hills of the Ardèche, in Gravières. Come meet our animals, climb through the suspended tree nets, let yourself be carried by the sensory trail, and step into the storytelling world of Gramado, guardian of dreams. Open daily this summer, 10am to 7pm — adult ticket €11, child (ages 3-12) €9, free under 3.
home.essentials_horaires_text:
Open every day this summer, 10am to 7pm.
Off-season: Wednesday, Saturday and Sunday.
home.univers_text: Here watches over Gramado, guardian of dreams, once guided by a kingfisher to this bend in the river. A legend is still told among the trees, carried by the wind and the blue glint of the water.
home.review1_text: A place to (re)connect with yourself and with nature that truly does you good. There's poetry in the air, beautiful energy.
home.review2_text: A magical place that truly does you good! A special energy, almost magic, that puts your heart back in place. You leave different, lighter.
home.review3_text: A lovely little corner of paradise for the whole family. Everything is here for wonder: nature, animals, treetop courses, a slide… and a bit of relaxation for the parents too!
home.heat_banner_text: Too hot outside? Come find some coolness with us! A visit 100% shaded by trees, river access, and misting fans on site.

lieu.text_1: L'Attrape-Rêves was born from a slightly crazy dream: to create a place where time slows down, where children run freely, where adults rediscover their inner child.
lieu.text_2: Located in Gravières, in the heart of the Ardèche Cévennes, this place cares for its animals all year round — donkeys, pygmy goats, chickens and pigs — while offering play areas, sensory exploration and living culture.
lieu.text_3: L'Attrape-Rêves is a farm like no other. A place where nature, art and play come together to offer a timeless escape.
lieu.text_fraicheur: The whole visit takes place in the shade of the trees, right along the river — a real haven of coolness, even on the hottest days. Misting fans are also set up on site to help you cool down further.
lieu.who_fabrique_text: The organisation behind L'Attrape-Rêves, La Fabrique aux Merveilles develops and manages this leisure park and discovery farm project.
lieu.who_compagnie_text: An association based on site, La Compagnie des Songes enlivens the place through animal-assisted activities, cultural events and workshops.

decouvrir.animaux_intro: This farm cares for its donkeys, pygmy goats, chickens and pigs all year round. Here we take the time to watch them, feed them, and pet them. A simple moment where genuine bonds with the living world are woven.
decouvrir.anes_desc: Our curious and tender long-eared friends.
decouvrir.chevres_desc: Mischievous, cuddly, and always ready to play.
decouvrir.poules_desc: They roam freely and run their little world.
decouvrir.cochons_desc: The kings of napping and good spirits.
decouvrir.animaux_note: More residents may join the family… Follow us to discover them!
decouvrir.sensoriel_text: Close your eyes. Walk barefoot. Listen to the wind in the leaves, touch the bark, feel the earth. The sensory trail at L'Attrape-Rêves is an invitation to rediscover the world with all your senses.
decouvrir.filets_text: Suspended among the branches, our nets offer an aerial course accessible to all from age 3, with no harness required. Climb, bounce, roll, explore the canopy in complete freedom and safety.
decouvrir.filets_badge: From age 3 • No harness • Completely safe
decouvrir.jeux_text: Games, distorting mirrors, musical instruments, a cool zone, hidden wonders… Everything here is designed to awaken the child within, spark the imagination and pique curiosity. We won't tell you everything… come and see!
decouvrir.arts_text: Shows, creative workshops, storytelling, music… Moments that punctuate the life of the place to surprise and inspire wonder. La Compagnie des Songes, an association based on site, brings these moments of sharing and cultural discovery to life. Check our events page for the programme.

infos.faq3_q: Can we have a picnic on site?
infos.faq3_a: Yes, there are dedicated picnic areas.
infos.faq4_q: Are the treetop nets suitable for toddlers?
infos.faq4_a: The course is accessible from age 3, with no harness required. Children must be accompanied by an adult.
infos.faq5_a: In case of heavy rain, we will close our doors. For more information, please check our website. If you have already purchased your tickets, they can be refunded or used at a later date.
infos.faq6_a: Yes, cancellations must be made at least 48 hours before the visit date. After that, no refund is possible. Contact us at contact@lattrapereves07.fr.
infos.faq7_a: Absolutely! However, some areas may be tricky to navigate — you can leave your pushchair with us if needed.
infos.faq8_a: Yes, although the treetop nets are not adapted for wheelchair users.
infos.faq9_a: Yes, a large free car park is available.
infos.faq10_q: What payment methods do you accept?
infos.faq10_a: Cash, bank cards, holiday vouchers. Online payment is also available.
infos.faq11_q: What should I wear for the visit?
infos.faq11_a: Come as you are :) Just be aware that the animals may occasionally (rarely) get clothes a little dirty.
infos.faq13_a: A changing area is available in the toilets.
infos.faq14_a: Yes! You can swim without needing to get back in the car! At the Vernède (subject to agreement with the campsite), at the Baumette, and at several other spots right next to L'Attrape-Rêves.
infos.faq15_a: The site is almost entirely shaded by trees and runs along the river — even on the hottest days, it stays cool. Misting fans are also set up on site to help you cool down further. However, don't forget to bring sun protection.
infos.faq16_q: Do I need to book in advance?

panneaux.page_subtitle: Select your language — the text of all signs will be displayed in the chosen language.
panneaux.p1_text:
It has been here for 300 million years.
What if you stopped for a moment to contemplate it?
To it, we are but a breath,
In an instant we will be gone...
panneaux.p2_text:
A whole family of stones from the river, polished by time. Limestone, granite, quartz...
We stack them one on top of the other to form cairns, or walls. A balance to find!
And you — how are the pebbles of your life stacked?
panneaux.p3_text:
Slowly, it climbs toward the sun to feed its roots and offers us its shade.
A network of fungi grows beneath its feet to communicate with other trees — we call it the Mycelium.
panneaux.p4_text:
8 solar panels.
20 kW of batteries — approximately 1.5 days of household consumption.
Sustainability assured!
panneaux.p5_title: The Kingfisher: The Blue Bird of Dreams
panneaux.p5_text:
It seems to be blue, but it is not — it is an illusion. In reality its feathers are brown.
As with its plumage, it matters little whether our dreams are real or not, as long as they are beautiful...
panneaux.p6_text:
Wherever they are in the world, all bamboos of the same species flower at the same time, then die.
Do they communicate with each other?
Have they been programmed for centuries?
Nobody really knows...
And it remains a beautiful mystery of life.
panneaux.p7_text:
This is where Granado fell asleep and the kingfisher guided him toward his childhood dreams.
① Whisper your dream to the whispering tree
② Ring the mushroom
③ And let life do the rest...
panneaux.p8_text:
Enter it as you would life — without expectation, without judgement.
Take a path, take time to stop wherever you feel alive.
Then carry on to wherever things are growing for you!
panneaux.p10_text:
Barefoot, in socks, or in shoes...
Take time to let the sensations wash over you.
What matters is not the destination, but the journey...

legende.p1: Once there was a man weary of a world grown grey and noisy, searching for a meaning he'd lost along the way. One night, a kingfisher with blue, rust and white feathers slipped into his dream and promised to lead him to a wonderful place.
legende.p2: On waking, Gramado — for that is his name — set off in search of this paradise, crossing deserts, mountains and towering forests. Exhausted, he finally fell asleep at the foot of a tree. The kingfisher reappeared and whispered a simple truth: "What you're looking for, you won't find at the end of the world." The bird led him to the banks of the Chassezac.
legende.p3: There, Gramado spoke with the dwellers of the place — a trout that had finally swum upstream, a stone carried along by the flood just as it had dreamed, a fox who knew every trick of the world, a donkey who had found his meadow, a goat who had stayed close to her family, a hen who never missed a sunrise, an oak that gave shade to everyone. And the kingfisher asked him the question that changed everything: "Do you remember what you wanted to build, when you were small?" Gramado remembered: harmony. A place where everyone would be happy, where nature would be beautiful, where people would smile at one another.
legende.p4: So he began to build, through storms, brigands and red tape. When his work was done, the grey clouds parted, nature grew stronger, birds sang more clearly, flowers opened — and people finally smiled. Since then, no one has seen Gramado again. Some say he went off in search of other rivers; others, that he became as elusive as the kingfisher himself. But when the light falls just right on the water of the Chassezac, a flash of blue sometimes appears — and those who see it remember, for the space of a wingbeat, their childhood dream.
legende.gramado_text: A man who set out in search of lost meaning, and ended up founding this place on the banks of the Chassezac — unknowingly fulfilling his childhood dream: to build a place where everyone would be happy.
legende.oiseau_text: A brilliantly coloured guide-bird, it reveals to Gramado that what he was looking for was already there. Its blue isn't really there at all: it's a trick of the light — just as dreams are the joyful reflection of our reality.
legende.spirit_intro: Everything at L'Attrape-Rêves is designed to revive four simple things:
legende.spirit1_text: Play like a kid again, let go of control, if only for a visit.
legende.spirit2_text: Small, gentle, unintended triggers that bring them back to the surface.
legende.spirit3_text: A quiet moment of introspection, at nature's own pace.
legende.spirit4_text: Surprises, beauty and art installations around every corner.

animaux.p1: At L'Attrape-Rêves, a discovery farm nestled in the Cévennes hills of the Ardèche, the animals aren't mere decoration: they're the real residents of the place, cared for all year round. This family activity in the Ardèche invites young and old alike to slow down, observe, and build a genuine bond with the living world.
animaux.p2: Our donkeys, with their curious, oversized ears, love a cuddle and a shared moment. The pygmy goats, playful and affectionate, are always up for a game. The hens wander freely, going about their own little world, and the pigs, kings of the afternoon nap, savour every quiet moment.
animaux.p3: Unlike a zoo, there's no glass or impersonal fencing here: you get close, you feed, you observe at animal height. It's a children's park in the Cévennes designed around gentle animal-assisted activities, run by La Compagnie des Songes, an association based on site year-round.
animaux.p4: Other residents may well join the family as the seasons go by — every visit could bring a new encounter.

filets.hero_subtitle: A suspended course open to children from age 3
filets.p1: Strung between the branches deep in the Ardèche forest, the nets at L'Attrape-Rêves offer a unique aerial course, with no harness or safety gear required. Climbing, bouncing, crawling, gently dropping down: this family activity in the Ardèche turns the treetops into a giant playground.
filets.p2: Open to children from age 3, the course is designed to be enjoyed safely without the constraints of a classic tree-climbing adventure course — no carabiners, no fixed route. Children explore at their own pace, under the watchful eye of an accompanying adult, while the netting stretched between the trees cushions falls and jumps.
filets.p3: It's one of the flagship activities at this children's park in the Cévennes: a suspended course that combines a sense of freedom, physical activity and a breathtaking view from the treetops. An experience just as loved by toddlers as by older kids, who'll fight not to come back down.
filets.p4: The treetop nets course is included in the standard admission ticket to L'Attrape-Rêves — no extra charge.

sensoriel.hero_subtitle: Rediscover the world with all your senses
sensoriel.p1: Close your eyes. Walk barefoot. At L'Attrape-Rêves, the sensory trail invites every visitor to slow down and explore nature differently — through touch, hearing and smell, far more than through sight.
sensoriel.p2: The path winds through different textures: pebbles, gravel, straw, moss, bark… Every step becomes a discovery, every surface a new sensation. It's a family activity in the Ardèche especially loved by children, who rediscover their balance and footing, but also by adults seeking a sensory break away from screens.
sensoriel.p3: This trail is part of the spirit of the place: a sensory haven at the heart of the living world, designed to recharge young and old alike. It's not just an attraction, but a genuine invitation to mindfulness, deep in the Cévennes hills of the Ardèche.
sensoriel.p4: Suitable for the whole family, with no prerequisites or special equipment, the sensory trail is open to every visitor of this children's park in the Cévennes, whatever their age.

jeux.hero_subtitle: Curiosities, surprises and moments of magic
jeux.p1: Among the trees and paths of L'Attrape-Rêves lie a thousand and one curiosities: distorting mirrors, open-air musical instruments, cool-down zones, surprising installations… Everything here is designed to awaken the child within and spark curiosity, whatever your age.
jeux.p2: This family activity in the Ardèche thrives on the unexpected: we won't tell you everything, the surprise is part of the fun. Around a bend, a musical mushroom, a giant colouring bubble, or a temporary art installation punctuates the stroll and creates moments to share between young and old.
jeux.p3: This children's park in the Cévennes cultivates the art of quiet wonder — no loud rides or queues, just a string of little marvels to discover at your own pace, as a family. It's also here that the highlights of La Compagnie des Songes come to life: shows, creative workshops and occasional events enrich the visit throughout the season.
jeux.p4: Check our events calendar so you don't miss the next get-together.
